note: Only places confirmed by phone or email go in 'local'. 'statewide' entries come from official program pages, checked on the date shown.

statewide.name: NJ Low-Cost Spay/Neuter Program
statewide.name_es: Programa de esterilización de bajo costo de NJ
statewide.summary: $10 spay or neuter for people on benefits like SNAP (Food Stamps), Medicaid, SSI, or Lifeline. $20 for pets adopted from a NJ shelter or pound.
statewide.summary_es: Esterilización por $10 para personas con beneficios como SNAP (cupones de alimentos), Medicaid, SSI o Lifeline. $20 para mascotas adoptadas de un refugio de NJ.
statewide.how: Call a participating vet to book. In Middlesex: Plainfield Animal Hospital (South Plainfield), Sayrebrook Veterinary Hospital (Sayreville), VCA Edgebrook Animal Hospital (East Brunswick). Bring your benefits ID.
statewide.how_es: Llame a un veterinario participante para hacer una cita. En Middlesex: Plainfield Animal Hospital (South Plainfield), Sayrebrook Veterinary Hospital (Sayreville), VCA Edgebrook Animal Hospital (East Brunswick). Traiga su identificación de beneficios.

statewide.name: NJ 2-1-1
statewide.summary: Help line, open 24/7, that connects New Jersey residents with food, housing, health, and other programs from a directory of over 6,300 services.
statewide.summary_es: Línea de ayuda, abierta 24/7, que conecta a los residentes de Nueva Jersey con programas de comida, vivienda, salud y más, de un directorio de más de 6,300 servicios.
statewide.how_es: Marque 2-1-1, envíe un texto al 898211 o busque en línea.
